meta.name: Alentejo Tech
meta.subtitle: From Sines' 1.2 GW data-centre campus to Évora's aerospace cluster and Beja's agritech labs — one ecosystem. A project from 351 Startups + Start Campus.

verticals.label: Data Centre & AI Infra
verticals.blurb: Hyperscale compute, AI training clusters, subsea connectivity — anchored at SINES DC.

verticals.label: Energy & Hydrogen
verticals.blurb: Green hydrogen, renewables, grid-scale storage — the Sines energy transition cluster.

verticals.label: Agritech
verticals.blurb: Precision irrigation, biotech, food systems — the Alqueva 130,000-ha innovation belt.

verticals.label: Aerospace & Industrial
verticals.blurb: Composite structures, defence platforms, UAV testing — anchored in Évora and Ponte de Sor.

verticals.label: Deep Tech
verticals.blurb: Earth observation, photonics, advanced materials — university spinouts across the region.

verticals.label: CleanTech
verticals.blurb: Circular industry, bio-economy, water — built on Alentejo's natural resource base.

verticals.label: AI & Software
verticals.blurb: Applied AI, data tooling, software-led ventures across the region.

verticals.label: Other Tech
verticals.blurb: SaaS, marketplaces, services and consumer tech.

incubators.name: Sines Tecnopolo (BIC Alentejo)
incubators.blurb: Science park and EU|BIC member founded 2007 by Município de Sines + IPBeja + IPSetúbal + U.Évora. Hosts 40+ SMEs across the Sines port-industrial complex.

incubators.name: Sines Tech — Innovation & Data Centre Hub
incubators.blurb: European Enterprise Promotion Awards 2023 winner. Open-access ecosystem linking subsea cables, hyperscale compute and renewable energy at Sines.

incubators.name: ÉvoraTech
incubators.blurb: ADRAL technology-based incubator (est. 2014) supporting 20+ companies in early-stage and acceleration phases. Operated with Município de Évora.

incubators.name: PACT — Parque do Alentejo de Ciência e Tecnologia
incubators.blurb: Évora's science & tech park. 50+ companies, 540+ workers, 9,000m² across six buildings (PACT 1.0–3.0). Aerospace, digital health, software.

incubators.name: BioBIP — Bioenergy & Business Incubator of Portalegre
incubators.blurb: IP Portalegre technology incubator (est. 2015) focused on 2nd-generation biofuels, energy recovery from waste and renewable-energy ventures.

incubators.name: StartUP Alentejo
incubators.blurb: Multisectoral incubator in Vendas Novas focused on creative and innovative projects. Member of the ADRAL incubator network.

incubators.name: CAESC — Centro de Apoio às Empresas de Santiago do Cacém
incubators.blurb: Litoral Alentejano business-support centre, part of the ADRAL incubator network. Industrial-cluster proximity to Sines.

incubators.name: CAME — Centro de Acolhimento Empresarial de Montemor-o-Novo
incubators.blurb: Central-Alentejo micro and SME incubator managed by ADRAL with Município de Montemor-o-Novo.

incubators.name: LINC Évora
incubators.blurb: ANJE-affiliated tech-startup launchpad in Évora. Coworking + early-stage support for software, mobile and digital-product founders.

rd_centers.name: Universidade de Évora
rd_centers.blurb: Public research university leading the Regional Technology Transfer System. Strengths in agronomy, earth sciences, heritage and renewable energy.

rd_centers.name: MED — Mediterranean Institute for Agriculture, Environment & Development
rd_centers.blurb: U.Évora-led associate laboratory on sustainable agriculture, soils, water and biodiversity for Mediterranean systems.

rd_centers.name: HERCULES Laboratory
rd_centers.blurb: Cultural-heritage diagnostics lab combining material science, imaging and analytical chemistry. PRR-funded modernisation underway.

rd_centers.name: ICT — Institute of Earth Sciences (Évora pole)
rd_centers.blurb: Earth-sciences associate laboratory; geophysics, geo-resources and environmental monitoring across the Alentejo.

rd_centers.name: Instituto Politécnico de Beja
rd_centers.blurb: Polytechnic with strong agronomy, biotech and engineering programmes. Anchors the Baixo-Alentejo R&D and CEBAL.

rd_centers.name: CEBAL — Centro de Biotecnologia Agrícola e Agro-Alimentar
rd_centers.blurb: Applied R&D centre on the IPBeja campus: agri-food biotech, valorisation of regional crops, bio-based products and tech transfer.

rd_centers.name: Instituto Politécnico de Portalegre
rd_centers.blurb: Alto-Alentejo polytechnic anchoring VALORIZA, C3i and the BioBIP incubator. Bio-economy, rural innovation and sustainability.

rd_centers.name: VALORIZA — Endogenous Resource Valorisation Centre
rd_centers.blurb: IP Portalegre research centre valorising endogenous bio-resources and shaping the regional bio-economy.

rd_centers.name: INIAV — Estação de Elvas
rd_centers.blurb: National Institute for Agricultural and Veterinary Research field station: cereals, viticulture and plant genetics.

anchors.name: Start Campus — SINES DC
anchors.blurb: Europe's largest sustainable data-centre campus. €8.5B investment, 1.2 GW IT capacity across 6 buildings (SIN01–SIN06), 100% renewable, PUE 1.1, OCP-Ready v2.

anchors.name: Microsoft × Nscale @ SIN01
anchors.blurb: $10B Microsoft AI build-out with Nscale and Start Campus. 12,600+ NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs at SIN01, scaling to 66,000+ NVIDIA Rubin GPUs from late 2027.

anchors.name: AICEP Global Parques — ZILS
anchors.blurb: Operator of the 2,375-ha Sines Industrial & Logistics Zone — Iberia's largest integrated industrial park, hosting €20B+ in committed investments.

anchors.name: APS — Administração dos Portos de Sines e do Algarve
anchors.blurb: Authority for the Port of Sines — Portugal's deepest deep-water port and the country's largest container, LNG and crude terminal.

anchors.name: Galp — Sines Refinery & Bioenergy
anchors.blurb: Galp's Sines complex — refining, biofuels, and a renewable-hydrogen pipeline in partnership with electrolyser projects on the Sines platform.

anchors.name: Repsol Polímeros — Sines
anchors.blurb: Petrochemicals complex producing polyolefins and circular-polymer feedstock; multi-hundred-million expansion programme on the Sines platform.

anchors.name: MadoquaPower2X (Madoqua × Power2X × CIP)
anchors.blurb: €1.3B Phase-1 / €2.8B full programme green hydrogen & ammonia project — 500 MW → 1.2 GW electrolysis. Breaks ground 2026; €245M EU Hydrogen Bank backing.

anchors.name: GreenH2Atlantic (ex-EDP Sines)
anchors.blurb: 100 MW EU-backed electrolyser repurposing the decommissioned Sines coal plant site into a renewable-hydrogen production hub.

anchors.name: EllaLink (Sines landing)
anchors.blurb: Direct EU–Brazil subsea cable. Sines is the European endpoint — the lowest-latency optical route between Lisbon and São Paulo.

anchors.name: Medusa Submarine Cable (Sines landing)
anchors.blurb: 24-fibre-pair Mediterranean cable, 480 Tbps capacity. Lands at Sines (Start Campus) — Atlantic-to-North-Africa connectivity.

anchors.name: Olisipo Submarine Cable (Sines ↔ Lisbon)
anchors.blurb: EllaLink-built 110-km domestic subsea link between Sines and Lisbon. 144 fibre pairs, 4.3 Pbps design capacity.

anchors.name: Aernnova Portugal (ex-Embraer Évora)
anchors.blurb: Aernnova's largest production centre worldwide. ~500 workers building metallic & composite aerostructures for KC-390, E-Jets and Praetor jets.

anchors.name: CEiiA Évora — LUS-222 Programme
anchors.blurb: Engineering centre at PACT developing the LUS-222 — the first aircraft fully designed, built and commercialised in Portugal. 100 engineers, €200M, maiden flight 2028.

anchors.name: Mecachrome Aeronáutica Évora
anchors.blurb: Precision-machining plant for titanium aerostructures and aero-engine parts. 300+ permanent jobs created via the EIB-financed 2017 Évora investment.

anchors.name: EDIA — Alqueva Multipurpose Project
anchors.blurb: Operator of Portugal's largest irrigated area (~130,000 ha), 72 reservoirs, 2,078 km of pipeline and 5 mini-hydro plants. The Alqueva agritech backbone.

anchors.name: Delta Cafés (Nabeiro Group)
anchors.blurb: Portugal's largest coffee group, headquartered in Campo Maior. Diversified food, hospitality and distribution business across Iberia.

anchors.name: Sovena Group
anchors.blurb: Olive-oil and vegetable-oil producer with major Alqueva-belt groves and milling operations — anchor of the Alentejo olive cluster.

startups.name: DECSIS
startups.blurb: Évora-headquartered IT engineering scale-up. Digital transformation, smart-city and energy-sector software across Iberia and Africa.

startups.name: SDAC
startups.blurb: PACT-resident aerospace component manufacturer. Composite-structures supply chain for the Évora aerospace cluster.

startups.name: ITGest
startups.blurb: PACT-resident IT services and software-engineering firm serving Alentejo industrial clients.

startups.name: TE Connectivity — Évora
startups.blurb: TE Connectivity engineering facility installed at PACT — connectivity and sensor solutions for aerospace and industrial clients.

startups.name: Peak & Peak
startups.blurb: PACT-resident software and digital-product venture serving Alentejo's enterprise and aerospace customers.

startups.name: Empowered Startups (Évora hub)
startups.blurb: Global founder visa & soft-landing programme. Opened Évora office at PACT to channel international founders into the Alentejo ecosystem.

startups.name: Fraunhofer Portugal (Évora node)
startups.blurb: Applied-research presence at PACT bringing AI and digital-product R&D capability into the Alentejo aerospace and health clusters.

startups.name: VC Silva
startups.blurb: PACT-resident industrial and aerospace-services firm — part of Évora's Aernnova-anchored manufacturing cluster.

startups.name: IP Parking
startups.blurb: PACT-resident urban-mobility venture — parking, sensors and access technology for Iberian smart-city customers.

startups.name: Keme Energy
startups.blurb: Portuguese ESCo and green-H₂ developer. €5.2M pilot at ZILS Sines (4 MW, 240 t H₂/yr). Recently won €38M project in the Sines Hydrogen Valley competition.

startups.name: Glintt — Global Intelligent Technologies
startups.blurb: Healthtech, software-engineering and digital-pharmacy scale-up. Founding member of PACT in Évora — investing in aeronautics-software practice.

programs.name: Alentejo Tech Launchpad
programs.blurb: Quarterly founder bootcamp run by 351 Startups + Start Campus. From idea to first hire and first paying customer.

programs.name: SIN AI Residency
programs.blurb: AI-builder residency hosted on the SINES DC campus. Access to GPU compute partners, hyperscaler programmes and AI engineering mentors.

programs.name: Alqueva Agritech Sprint
programs.blurb: Field-scale agritech sprint across Alqueva's 130,000-ha irrigation perimeter. Pilots with cooperatives, EDIA and CEBAL.

programs.name: Sines Energy Builders
programs.blurb: Green-hydrogen, electrolyser and grid-edge venture programme co-run by Sines Tecnopolo and the green-H₂ anchors on the Sines platform.

programs.name: Évora Aerospace Studio
programs.blurb: Studio for engineer-founders building composite-structures, UAV and defence-tech ventures. Anchored at PACT, Aernnova and the Évora aerodrome.

programs.name: Portugal Tech Week — Alentejo Track
programs.blurb: Decentralised festival edition: a regional track of 100+ events landing in Évora, Sines and Beja each September.

programs.name: BioBIP Bioenergy Cohort
programs.blurb: IP Portalegre incubation cohort focused on 2nd-generation biofuels, waste-to-energy and rural-renewable ventures.

programs.name: Alentejo Founders Circle
programs.blurb: Curated peer circle for Series-A+ founders in the Alentejo and their corporate counterparts at the region's anchor employers.

events.title: SIN01 Campus Tour & AI Briefing
events.blurb: Behind-the-scenes at Europe's largest sustainable data-centre campus. AI-infrastructure briefing for founders.

events.title: Évora Aerospace Founders Day
events.blurb: Cluster meetup at PACT: composite-structures, UAVs, defence-tech. Aernnova × PACT × U.Évora.

events.title: Alqueva Agritech Field Day
events.blurb: Field-pilot day across Alqueva's irrigation perimeter — cooperatives meet precision-ag founders.

events.title: Sines Green Hydrogen Summit
events.blurb: Annual summit on green-H₂ project pipelines, off-take strategy and EU funding mechanisms.

events.title: CEBAL Agri-Biotech Open Lab
events.blurb: IPBeja lab open day for biotech and agri-food founders. Tech-transfer office, instruments and pilot facilities.

events.title: Startup Weekend Évora
events.blurb: 54-hour idea-to-MVP sprint at ÉvoraTech. Run by 351 Startups + Techstars Community Leader Academy.

events.title: Portugal Tech Week 2026 — Alentejo
events.blurb: Regional track of Portugal Tech Week — events landing in Évora, Sines and Beja across one week.

events.title: Sines Tech Investor Mixer
events.blurb: VCs, corporates and hyperscaler programme managers meet AI-infrastructure and energy founders at Sines Tech.

perks.blurb: Cloud credits + technical office hours for Alentejo-based founders.
Founders Hub credits — plus discovery sessions on the SINES AI infrastructure programme.
NVIDIA Inception, technical credits and GPU compute discovery via the Nscale × Start Campus deployment.
European-sovereign infrastructure for AI, deep-tech and regulated workloads.
Cloud Program credits + access to Google for Startups accelerators.
Fee-free processing for the first €20k of revenue.
6 months free Notion Plus for the whole team.
HubSpot for Startups: CRM + marketing automation.
Startup-friendly corporate legal advice — first 20 hours on the house.
ADRAL incubator network sponsors StartUP Visa for international founders moving into the Alentejo.

mentors.name: ADRAL Investment Team
mentors.blurb: Alentejo regional development agency. Public funding pathways, EU programmes and the incubator network.

mentors.name: Pedro Carrana
mentors.blurb: Sines port-industrial cluster. Subsea cables, energy transition and industrial collaboration models.

mentors.name: Soumodip Sarkar
mentors.blurb: Science-to-startup at U.Évora. Technology transfer, ecosystem strategy, founder development.

mentors.name: PACT Innovation Team
mentors.blurb: Évora aerospace, digital-health and software cluster. Soft-landing for international and Lisbon-based scale-ups.

mentors.name: CEBAL Agri-Biotech Team
mentors.blurb: Agri-food biotech tech-transfer, IP licensing and pilot facilities for plant-science founders.

mentors.name: Catarina Palma
mentors.blurb: Portugal's largest startup association. Programmes, corporate partnerships and Alentejo founder visibility.

mentors.name: Catarina Selada
mentors.blurb: Operator of ZILS — Iberia's largest industrial park. Land, permitting and anchor-customer pathways.

mentors.name: Stephan Morais
mentors.blurb: Leading deep-tech & fintech VC in Iberia. Fund strategy, board roles and Portuguese ecosystem building.

mentors.name: Hugo Teixeira
mentors.blurb: Iberian climate accelerator. EU Green Deal funding, hydrogen and circular-industry pilots.

mentors.name: Pedro Ribeiro Santos
mentors.blurb: Energy corporate VC. CVC strategy, utility partnerships, cleantech pilots.

mentors.name: Aernnova Évora Engineering
mentors.blurb: Composite & metallic aerostructures at scale. Supply-chain partnerships for aerospace founders.

success_stories.name: Start Campus
success_stories.blurb: €8.5B, 1.2 GW. From greenfield to Europe's largest sustainable data-centre campus in under a decade.

success_stories.name: Microsoft AI @ Sines
success_stories.blurb: $10B AI build-out with Nscale at SIN01 — 12,600+ NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs in production.

success_stories.name: MadoquaPower2X
success_stories.blurb: €2.8B green-hydrogen & ammonia programme; €245M EU Hydrogen Bank backing; breaks ground 2026.

success_stories.name: Aernnova Évora
success_stories.blurb: Aernnova's largest production centre worldwide. ~500 jobs building KC-390, E-Jet and Praetor aerostructures.

success_stories.name: EDIA / Alqueva
success_stories.blurb: Portugal's largest irrigated area — 130,000 ha of precision-agriculture surface, the regional agritech engine.

success_stories.name: Sines as Atlantic Hub
success_stories.blurb: Six subsea cables landing or planned (EllaLink, Medusa, Olisipo, Nuvem, 2Africa, Equiano) — Iberia's optical gateway.
